about_the_game:
You play as Secret Agent Mike Rogers, assigned to track down and capture the fugitive terrorists known only as the Velvet Twins. Set across stylish, danger-filled locations, you’ll fight through unforgettable 1960s stages — from neon-lit Las Vegas, gritty Chinatown, and abandoned factories, all the way to a shootout in a Wild West village!

Originally appearing as a boss in Dragon Climax, Mike now takes center stage. He can take down enemies with his bare hands, but when things get serious, he'll grab whatever weapons are available — from pistols and swords to baseball bats and even a submachine gun.

1964: Operation Velvet Twins delivers pure retro fun with no filler — just tight gameplay, explosive action, and an unmistakable 8-bit flavor. If you loved the golden era of your Master System, you're going to feel right at home.

Features:

  • Play as Mike Rogers, secret agent from Dragon Climax!
  • Punch your way through waves of enemies!
  • Pick up firearms when the mission gets intense!
  • Use a variety of weapons: swords, bats, crates, and more!
  • Defeat 8 eccentric bosses!
  • Fight across 7 unique 1960s-inspired locations!
  • Retro visuals and music in authentic 8-bit style!
  • Collect dollars — spend them on power-ups or save them to raise your score!
  • A thrilling 1960s B-movie spy story!
  • Unlock tons of achievements!

  • OS *: XP, Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

  • Memory: 512 MB RAM

short_description: A retro-style action-platformer that blends the stealth shootouts of Rolling Thunder with the raw brawling of Double Dragon. The result? A thrilling 2D spy adventure set in the 1960s — packed with fists, bullets, and classic arcade energy!!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal
